readings: For each piece of equipment (`scanenvironment.equipref`), average its relative humidity (`humepct`), ignoring missing readings. Keep only equipment whose average is above the average of all equipment averages. For these, show the equipment reference, its average humidity, how much that exceeds the all-equipment average, and how far it is from the mean humidity of just the kept equipment. Return nothing if either reference average is missing. Sort by that last difference from highest to lowest with missing values last, and return exactly 10 rows, dropping any extra rows tied at 10th place arbitrarily.
queries:
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq
),
kept AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS kept_avg FROM kept
)
SELECT
  k.equipref,
  k.avg_hum AS avg_humidity,
  k.avg_hum - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall_avg,
  k.avg_hum - km.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_avg
FROM kept k, overall o, kept_mean km
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND km.kept_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
